title: The PODIUM Study - a Three-arm Comparison of Target Therapies After Anti-TNFα in Ulcerative Colitis
official: Real-life Comparative Effectiveness of Vedolizumab, Ustekinumab and JAK Inhibitors in Patients with Ulcerative Colitis After Anti-TNFα Failure or Intolerance
summary: The goal of this observational study is to compare the real-life effectiveness and safety of vedolizumab, ustekinumab and JAK inhibitors in patients with UC who had been exposed to at least one anti-TNF-alpha therapy.
